title: Residue cohomology from any bounded-above free stalk model
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], E an object of D(O_X), x a point, and G a cochain complex of structure-sheaf modules with Q(G) isomorphic to E [def-pc-derived-category]. Let K be a bounded-above complex of free [def-weil-pbc-free-module] modules over R = O_X,x, with Q(K) isomorphic to Q(G_x), where G_x is the termwise module stalk [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. For every integer i there is a kappa(x)-linear equivalence from derivedFiberCohomology X E i x [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti] to H^i(kappa(x) tensor_R K), the homology of termwise extension along the residue map [def-weil-residue-field]. The ring residue field is definitionally the scheme residue field. No local strict perfection, finite rank of the free terms, or finite-dimensionality hypothesis is imposed. The sheaf and ring derived categories may have different morphism universes.

source.place: Tags 06YB, 064K and 0098; K-flat stalks and residue pullback computation

proof.text: Take a K-flat sheaf resolution s:P→G. Its localized map is invertible; compose Q(s) with eG to obtain Q(P)≅E. Exactness of the module stalk functor implies it preserves homology, so its termwise image of s is a quasi-isomorphism. Compose eK with the inverse of Q(s_x) to obtain Q(K)≅Q(P_x). The stalk criterion makes P_x K-flat.

The supplied strict upper bound gives the boundedness hypothesis of acyclic_mapBifunctor_of_boundedAbove_flat, and Module.Flat.of_free gives flatness of each K term. Thus K is K-flat. Apply the scalar extension homology comparison to K and P_x with their derived isomorphism and the residue map.

Compute derivedFiberCohomology from the K-flat sheaf P and its isomorphism to E, using the K-flat stalk residue cohomology comparison. Compose its linear equivalence with the inverse scalar extension comparison from the previous step. This gives the original statement in all degrees without changing its hypotheses or universes.

theorem nonempty_stalkFree_residueCohomology_linearEquiv
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (x : X)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (X.residueField x)).toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x))]
    (G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (eG : DerivedCategory.Q.obj G ≅ E)
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ℤ)
    (b : ℤ) (hb : K.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hfree : ∀ j : ℤ, Module.Free (X.presheaf.stalk x) (K.X j))
    (eK : DerivedCategory.Q.obj K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj G)) (i : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (derivedFiberCohomology X E i x ≃ₗ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField
      (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
        ((((ModuleCat.extendScalars
          (IsLocalRing.residue (X.presheaf.stalk x))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K).homology i))
